text.p: Tropical Storm Andres, with 50 mph winds, is just off the coast of the Mexico/Guatemala Border and is moving east at 6 mph. It will move inland and weaken this period across northern Guatemala and Belize. Heavy rain and flooding will be the main problem with this system, especially in western areas where mudslides are possible. Wind damage is possible along the immediate coast over the next few hours.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
